api_under_test: createApp({ i18n: { supported: ['en', 'ja'] } }): per-request locale detection (?locale= query, the `locale` cookie, Accept-Language, in that order) and the shared Inertia prop _i18n carrying the active + fallback catalogs
lang/<locale>/*.json catalogs (one namespace per file, nested keys), typed keys from guren codegen (.guren/translations.gen.ts)
useTranslation() from @guren/inertia-client (t / tc / locale) in the layout and the posts pages
this.t() in controllers for server-rendered text (the dashboard document title passed to this.inertia())
a POST /locale route with a zod body contract (z.enum(['en','ja'])) read through this.validated(), so an unsupported value is the framework's 422
writing the detection's own cookie (`locale`) on the redirect via this.redirect(url, { headers }), and isSafeRedirectUrl() to send the reader back to the Referer
guren check --i18n key parity between lang/en and lang/ja
harness_signal: src/app.ts already carries `i18n: { supported: ['en'] }` with a comment naming the three detection sources (?locale=, a locale cookie, Accept-Language) and the typed keys for t()/useTranslation(); guren context lists the i18n options, useTranslation() and this.t(); guren check (and --i18n) reports key parity between lang/<locale> directories and unreachable dotted keys. So a shipped agent should add 'ja' to supported, drop lang/ja/*.json beside lang/en, write the `locale` cookie the detection already reads from a POST /locale action with a body schema, and swap page copy for t(). What no command tells it: the framework has no helper that writes the locale cookie (the action builds the Set-Cookie itself) and no redirect-back helper (read Referer, guard it). Traps: registering /locale inside the guest group (signed-in users bounce to /dashboard), a custom cookie name the detection never reads (then a hand-written middleware is needed), a key like posts.search that is both a string and a parent of posts.search.placeholder (unreachable, and check --i18n fails), and forgetting the pre-existing messages.welcome in lang/ja (parity fails). A bare agent may hand-roll an Accept-Language parser, a cookie parser and a locale ternary or translations[locale][key] table in the pages.
